artifact_status: local proxy gate passed; TIF written for manual provenance review; not organizer-scored or automatically submitted
data_provenance: pinned public owner-maintained mirror; not organizer-authenticated

duplicate_audit.scope: all readable .tif files under local docs/, data/, and outputs/ with matching one-band grid and footprint; not a global competition-upload archive

gate.criterion: nested outer-fold mean delta > 0 and at least the registered number of positive tiles against both tmi_hg and the frozen H35-01 incumbent, with matched actual pixel mass across challenger, baseline and incumbent in every outer tile
gate.slot_note: This proxy screen never spends a competition slot. Input rasters are a public owner-maintained mirror, not organizer-authenticated; the labels are existing catalogue faults, not the hidden newly identified target; and this geography was previously exposed.

generative_ai_use.competitor_responsibility: The registered competitor must independently verify code, scientific claims, data rights/provenance, artifact validity, and all final submission statements.
generative_ai_use.extent: Arena.ai Agent Mode assisted with source review, geological-hypothesis framing, design-of-experiments planning, code implementation, test design, and documentation. Repository scripts generated the candidate raster and experiment artifacts from the local inputs.

holdout_reuse_note: H35-01 through H35-05 previously summarized this known-catalogue label geography. Each outer tile is excluded from its own H35-06 configuration selection, but prior exposure makes this exploratory nested spatial CV, not an untouched independent confirmation or validation against newly identified private faults.

incumbent.comparison: rescored at each selected challenger's prediction fraction and matched to identical actual emitted mass
